statement: Requirement HK-REQ-025 states that standard V0 payment and consolidation plans must delegate UTXO selection, mass calculation, KIP-9 storage mass validation, and fee estimation to the official kaspa-wasm Generator and verify strict value conservation.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-025 states that standard V0 payment and consolidation plans must delegate UTXO selection, mass calculation, KIP-9 storage mass validation, and fee estimation to the official kaspa-wasm Generator and verify strict value conservation.
rationale: Mandates specific computational and structural behaviors for payment and consolidation planning.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-026 states that when planning RPC transactions, the UTXO provider must query the node mempool to exclude pending-spent inputs and fail closed with PENDING_SPEND_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE if mempool visibility is unavailable.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-026 states that when planning RPC transactions, the UTXO provider must query the node mempool to exclude pending-spent inputs and fail closed with PENDING_SPEND_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE if mempool visibility is unavailable.
rationale: Specifies mandatory functional behavior regarding mempool querying and conditional error handling.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-027 states that the payment planner and signer must automatically exclude covenant UTXOs from ordinary payment selection and reject any attempt to spend a covenant UTXO in a V0 payment with COVENANT_UTXO_NOT_PAYMENT_INPUT.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-027 states that the payment planner and signer must automatically exclude covenant UTXOs from ordinary payment selection and reject any attempt to spend a covenant UTXO in a V0 payment with COVENANT_UTXO_NOT_PAYMENT_INPUT.
rationale: Defines strict functional rules for filtering inputs and executing rejection logic.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-028 states that version-1 transaction plans must validate non-empty inputs and outputs, value conservation, fee ceiling bounds (maxFeeSompi), u16 compute budgets (0 to 65535), covenant group invariants, and zero embedded secrets.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-028 states that version-1 transaction plans must validate non-empty inputs and outputs, value conservation, fee ceiling bounds (maxFeeSompi), u16 compute budgets (0 to 65535), covenant group invariants, and zero embedded secrets.
rationale: Defines validation checks and invariants that the system must enforce during transaction planning.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-029 states that every planned payment must enforce a maximum fee ceiling (defaulting to 10,000,000 sompi / 0.1 KAS) and reject node fee-rate estimates exceeding maxFeeRate (default 10,000 sompi/gram) with FEE_RATE_ABOVE_BOUND.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-029 states that every planned payment must enforce a maximum fee ceiling (defaulting to 10,000,000 sompi / 0.1 KAS) and reject node fee-rate estimates exceeding maxFeeRate (default 10,000 sompi/gram) with FEE_RATE_ABOVE_BOUND.
rationale: Specifies fee enforcement functionality and error code behavior for payments.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-030 states that the Kaspa RPC client must verify node network identity and sync status (isSynced: true) on connect and right before broadcast, implement a 3-state circuit breaker for reads, and never auto-retry submitTransaction broadcasts.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-030 states that the Kaspa RPC client must verify node network identity and sync status (isSynced: true) on connect and right before broadcast, implement a 3-state circuit breaker for reads, and never auto-retry submitTransaction broadcasts.
rationale: Mandates specific networking, state verification, and execution policy behaviors for the RPC client.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-032 states that the managed localnet controller shall orchestrate a Dockerized rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 simnet node with container and image digest verification, automated CPU miner coinbase maturity funding, and local UTXO snapshot/restore.
refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-032 states that the managed localnet controller shall orchestrate a Dockerized rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 simnet node with container and image digest verification, automated CPU miner coinbase maturity funding, and local UTXO snapshot/restore.
rationale: Specifies orchestrator capabilities and container management functions required by the system.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-031 states that on Windows Node.js environments, the RPC transport must wrap the ws package WebSocket in GuardedWebSocket to prevent native libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion crashes on repeated connection teardown.
refined_statement: The Windows Node.js RPC transport shall wrap the ws package WebSocket in GuardedWebSocket to achieve 0 native libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion crashes during 10,000 consecutive connection teardowns.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-033 states that the in-memory simulator shall execute synthetic Kaspa transactions, GHOSTDAG topology approximations, and ScriptVM checks in sub-milliseconds while identifying itself as 2.1.0-kaspa-simulator so it is never mistaken for a real consensus node.
refined_statement: The in-memory simulator shall execute synthetic Kaspa transactions, GHOSTDAG topology approximations, and ScriptVM checks with a execution latency of ≤ 0.9 ms per operation, and shall return the exact version string '2.1.0-kaspa-simulator' in its node identification handshake.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-036 states that background localnet CPU mining should enforce a bounded block cap or target balance watchdog so unbounded mining over many hours does not accumulate hundreds of thousands of UTXOs and exceed the 100 MiB WebSocket frame limit on getUtxosByAddresses.
refined_statement: The background localnet CPU mining module shall enforce a bounded block cap or target balance watchdog to ensure UTXO accumulation never exceeds 50,000 items and `getUtxosByAddresses` WebSocket payloads remain strictly ≤ 100 MiB during continuous 24-hour mining operations.
